nodes.label: Negative Self-Distillation: Learning to Reason by Avoiding Flaws
nodes.author: Rongcan Pei; Zhepei Wei; Shuyao Xu; Xinyu Zhu; Wei-Lin Chen; Yu Meng
nodes.rationale: Forcing a student to imitate a gold-conditioned confident teacher suppresses uncertainty and self-correction; training the model to move away from a self-generated careless 'negative teacher' avoids this without any ground-truth answer.

nodes.label: Gated unlikelihood training against a self-generated negative teacher
nodes.rationale: A positive-part gate (negative-teacher prob minus reference prob) flags only tokens the negative condition specifically increased, and a sigmoid squashes the penalty to prevent gradient explosion on high-confidence tokens.

hyperedges.label: On-policy distillation flaw diagnosis and teacher-free replacement
